name: Jintuo Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Jintuo Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of aluminum alloy precision die castings in China and internationally. The company offers gearbox, guide wheel, valve plate, throttle, and filter components; seat belt components, damping component, and vacuum pump; lights, assisted driving camera, rearview mirror, and wiper; and air conditioning system components, horn, and radiator.
